name: Product Feed Manager by Conversios: Google Shopping, TikTok, Meta & 100+ Channels
author: Conversios

sections.description:
Conversios Product Feed Manager for WooCommerce helps store owners create and manage accurate product catalogs for Google Shopping, Facebook (Meta), and TikTok from one place.
Accurate and consistent product data improves product approval rates by ensuring prices, availability, variants, and attributes meet channel requirements and reduce disapprovals.
Automatic feed updates keep product information in sync as your WooCommerce catalog changes, helping reduce revenue loss caused by feed errors such as mismatched pricing or outdated availability.
Clean and optimized product catalogs improve Shopping and Performance Max campaign delivery, helping advertisers achieve higher ROAS from Shopping and Performance Max ads without manual feed maintenance.
Conversios provides a no code setup to generate channel ready catalogs, map required attributes, and manage platform specific requirements while maintaining full control over how products appear across channels.

In a WooCommerce case study, a high-volume fashion brand fixed catalog and tracking issues using Conversios product sync and Facebook CAPI, achieving 100% error-free product sync for 130,000+ products across Facebook Shops and Google Merchant Center. This led to better conversion tracking, a ~20% increase in conversions, and a ~15% ROAS uplift. See the full case study)

Reviews

“We have been using this plugin for over a year and it has been consistently reliable. During our initial setup, the support team was responsive and provided quick, helpful assistance. Highly recommended.”
@braincom75 (Read full review)

What Problem We Solve

WooCommerce store owners often face product disapprovals, lost ad visibility, and revenue loss due to inaccurate or outdated product feed data. Manual feed updates, mismatched pricing, incorrect availability, and missing attributes can cause Shopping and marketplace ads to stop serving or perform poorly.

Conversios solves this by keeping product catalogs accurate and consistently synced across Google Shopping, Facebook (Meta), and TikTok. It helps reduce feed errors, improve product approval rates, and ensure sellable products are correctly listed as your catalog changes.

Features We Provided

  • Generate product feeds in XML, CSV, TSV, and TXT formats for all major marketing platforms.
  • Create product feeds for 100+ shopping and advertising channels across 200+ countries
  • Add custom attributes like Brand, GTIN, Age Group, Gender, and more without extra plugins or coding.
  • Automatically generate and update product feeds using scheduled sync intervals.
  • Keep product data synced in real time with Google Shopping, TikTok, Facebook, Bing, and other channels.
  • Select specific products for feeds and campaigns using advanced filters and flexible product rules.
  • Map product categories and attributes for each channel to meet different feed requirements.
  • Works smoothly with popular WooCommerce plugins and themes.
  • Handle large product catalogs efficiently without affecting store performance.
  • View real-time product approval status and quickly fix feed disapprovals.
  • Clean and user-friendly interface for easy feed setup and management.

Best Fit for Which Stores

  • WooCommerce stores selling physical or digital products
  • Businesses listing products on shopping, social, or marketplace platforms
  • Stores managing medium to large product catalogs
  • Merchants who want better control over product data without manual feed files
  • Teams looking for a no code solution without developer involvement

Setup in Minutes & Faster Time to Value

  • No code setup to manage product feeds without developer help
  • Choose the sales channels where you want to list your products
  • Match your WooCommerce product details with channel requirements
  • Product prices, availability, and details stay updated automatically
  • Maintain consistent product information with minimal ongoing effort

Support

sections.installation:
1. Install via WordPress Dashboard

* Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
* Go to Plugins > Add New.
* Search for Product Feed Manager for Woocommerce by conversios
* Click Install Now, then Activate.

  1. Manual Installation

* Download the plugin ZIP file from WordPress.org.
* In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New.
* Click Upload Plugin and select the downloaded ZIP file.
* Click Install Now, then Activate.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with other WooCommerce plugins?

The plugin works with standard WooCommerce product data and is compatible with most popular WooCommerce plugins and themes. Compatibility may vary based on customization.

Why should I use this WooCommerce product feed plugin?

This plugin helps you generate accurate and optimized product feeds for Google Shopping, Meta, TikTok, and 100+ channels from one place. It reduces feed errors, improves product approval rates, and keeps product data updated automatically without manual file handling.

For which channels can I generate product feeds?

You can create product feeds for major shopping, marketing, and marketplace platforms such as Google Shopping (Google Merchant Center), Microsoft Merchant Center, Meta (Facebook Catalog), TikTok Catalog, Pinterest, Snapchat, and 100+ global and country-specific channels.

Can I create feeds for platforms not listed?

Yes. You can generate product feeds in standard formats such as XML, CSV, TSV, and TXT. These feeds can be used with other platforms or marketplaces that accept standard feed files.

Can I generate a Google Shopping product feed for WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin allows you to create a Google Shopping product feed that meets Google Merchant Center requirements using pre-built templates and attribute mapping tools.

Does the plugin support variable products and product variations?

Yes. The plugin supports WooCommerce variable products and includes all associated product variations in the generated feeds.

How are product updates handled?

Product feeds use your WooCommerce product data. When prices, stock, availability, or product details change, the plugin syncs updated data automatically based on the configured feed sync intervals.

Can this plugin auto-update my product feeds?

Yes. You can configure scheduled feed sync intervals to automatically update product prices, availability, and details across connected channels.

Is there a limit to the number of products in a feed?

Yes. The free version of the plugin supports up to 100 products per feed. Product limits may vary based on the selected plan. Performance may also depend on your hosting environment and server resources.

Can I control how often product data is synced?

Yes. You can configure feed sync intervals to update product data every 7, 15, or 25 days across connected channels.

What file formats are supported?

The plugin supports standard product feed formats including XML, CSV, TSV, and TXT. These formats are accepted by most shopping, marketing, and marketplace platforms.

What if my products are disapproved on Google Shopping or Meta?

Product disapprovals are usually caused by missing or incorrect data such as pricing, availability, or required attributes. The plugin helps identify and fix feed-level issues by mapping required fields and reviewing product data. Final approval decisions are determined by each platform’s policies.

Does the plugin support multiple languages and currencies?

Product feeds are generated using the data available in WooCommerce. If your store uses multilingual or multi-currency plugins, the feeds will reflect that data based on your store configuration.

What is the difference between the free and paid versions?

The free version allows you to generate optimized product feeds for major channels with core features such as attribute mapping and scheduled updates, with a product syncing limit of up to 100 products per feed. Paid plans offer higher product syncing limits and additional feed management and configuration options depending on the selected plan.

How do I get support if I need help?

If you need help with setup, feed syncing, or troubleshooting, you can contact our support team at info@conversios.io or reach out via WhatsApp for faster assistance: Chat on WhatsApp
